t: You're on Savile Row, the Mayfair street known above all for traditional bespoke tailoring for men. It also has some famous addresses. At number one was the Royal Geographical Society, where British explorations to Africa and the South Pole were planned. At number three were the headquarters of the Beatles' Apple Corps, and on that roof the band gave its final live performance. The street takes its name from Dorothy Boyle, Countess of Burlington, a courtier and occasional painter. Several people died along the row, among them the politician George Tierney and Admiral of the Fleet John Forbes.
